title: Cosmic Cowboy on Bull
description: A luminous spectral cowboy wearing a hat and bandana rides a glowing longhorn bull while playing an electric guitar. The surreal scene features swirling light trails, floating musical notes, colorful orbs, and streaking celestial objects against a bright pastel sky with a radiant sun on the horizon.
